title: Q-ULTRA-country-snapshot-uptime-REDESIGN: every second-order step failed to bring Uptime back in bounds; redesign
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** ladder exhausted for `country-snapshot:uptime`
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --check

The same failure three times is a design defect (GUIDING-DIRECTIVE section 2): change the structure, not the parameter.
